```lean
theorem lg_target {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (Φ : ZMod N → ℂ) {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) : LSeriesSummable (fun x => Φ ↑x) s := by
  let c := (finset.univ.map (λ x : ZMod N, abs (Φ x))).sup
  have bounded_Φ : ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ x : ZMod N, |Φ x| ≤ c := ⟨c, λ x, begin
    rw ← real.coe_abs,
    exact le_supr _ x
  end⟩
  let f : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => Φ (ZMod.ofNat n)
  have h_bound : ∀ n : ℕ, abs (f n) ≤ c := λ n, begin
    rw ← real.coe_abs,
    exact le_supr _ (ZMod.ofNat n)
  end
  have h_abs_convergent : LSeriesAbsolutelyConvergent f s :=
    lseries_absolutely_convergent_of_real_part_gt_one hs h_bound
  exact LSeriesSummable.of_absolutely_convergent h_abs_convergent
```
